body:
I have decided to share this experiance with others on my experiances and findings on this most bueatiful substance!  I first read shulgins first book in the early nineties and was always facinated with trying these substances,unfortunatly procuring these chemicals at the time was extremly difficult!
anyway,finally i was able to track down certain places to obtain some of these chemicals and placed my first order,two weeks later i recieved a package in the mail containing 1g 2c-t-7,1g 2c-i and 1gram 2c-e. i had heard moslt about the 2c-i and had read and heard many reports of it being a great drug,now i had it in my possesion,there was only one thing to do,try it out!
In this next section i will relate my experiments with the substance 2c-1 and explain doses,effects,and the diffrent forms of administration used(i.e..oral,i.v).
march 11 2005
dosage:15mg 2c-i in gel cap
time ingested:12.00am
12.30:slight awarreness that somthiong is happening,small bursts of energy,no visuals noted as yet,slight colour enhancement.
1.00am..starting to feel lots of energy,no visuals noted,drug still has not tacken full affect!
2.00:lots of energy.good feelings all over,happy,talkative,but nothing in the way of visuals or anything of a truelly hallucinogenic nature!
3.00am:drug has definatly peaked,i am slighly dissapointed,15mg was to low a dose,will try 25 next time!
4.ooam:a few pipes of cannabis and i was ready to hit the sack,great sleep,no hangover or any ill affeects felt next day!
march 20 2005
dose:25mg oral gel cap
time ingested:10.30pm
11.00pm:starting to feel bursts of energy,deffinatly aware of something!
11.30pm:the drug is starting to take affect,my visual feild is flashing,i am starting to enjoy this!!!
12.15am march 21 2005:waves are coming over me,i feel like each wave is taking me further and further into some mystical land,the waves keep coming more intense,i am transferred to another place,this is unreal!!!!
shortly after the drug took full affect and it is quite hard to relate in words my experiance,but...it was great!!!
after finally coming out of my great world,i felt pretty tired and fried,i took 4 10 mg valium,had a few pipes of cannabis and driffted off into a blissfull sleep!
next day i was full of energy and feeling great!time to ponder my next experiment.what dose to try next!i felt the 25mg was a great experiance,but i felt i was missing the real magic in this most magnificent substance,and wanted to find out what the substance was capable of!i must also at this time express,that just because these doses appeared to be safe to me,everybody is diffrent!
the chemicals mentioned hear are reffered to as 'research chemicals'there is  no scientific research done on these chemicals and very little is known about them!
there for it is up to researches like myself to experiment with these substances, i have a deep love for psy drugs and am an experianced psyconuat,and although it is never safe to igest any substance,i take as many precautions as possible,i ALWAYS measure the substances with high quality lab scales(high quality electrronic scales are fine as long as they measure down to at least 0.001.
anyway,on with the experaice:11 april 2005
substance:2c-i
dose:40mg
method:oral gel cap
1.00am.ingested the jelly cap and had my girlfreind with me to babby sit,since it was a hight dose!
i knew i would be in for an absolutly great time!
the onset was pretty much the same as with the 25mg,around the same time to come on,but when it finally kicked in fully,thats when things changed!
visuals were appearing out of everywhere,i hadn,t felt like this since i whent overboard on some liquid a few years back!things started to get real intense!!!but i was rweally enjoying it,then suddenly iwas feeling more flushes coming over me!just the same as when it,s starting to fully come on,but 10 times as intense!
all of a sudden i couldn,t see more than a foot in front of me,the visuals were crazy,no mater what i did,close my eyes,open them,the visuals were there,i could conjure anything i wanted in my mind,it was great!
the rest of however many hours i tripped were great,and i had an extremy fun time!
i felt no ill affects the next day!i felt fine,this is truely a freindly drug!!!
i have also dosed 55mg 2c-i,and injected 25mg 2c-i into my vein!
i will add these reports and my findings on these as well as other substances:2c-t-7,2c-t-2,2c-t-4,2c-e,2c-c,4fmp,doi 5-meo-dmt!
remember people,please take care when using these chemicals
